title: Rayuela: `--hijo` cannot select the child the session starts on
notes: 2026-11-09 `rayuela faltas --hijo Leia` failed with "Rayuela child is
unknown or ambiguous; offered children: 927147: Quintanilla García, Mía",
because the switcher omits the current child. Leia was only readable by
omitting `--hijo`, and after a switch to Mía there is no way back in the
same run. Next step: resolve `--hijo` against `rayuela hijos` (NIA and
name) and treat the current child as a no-op selection.
result: Resolve the explicitly requested pupil against the roster, keep the active pupil, and verify any real switch before reading.
evidence: TZ=UTC pnpm exec vitest run src/rayuela src/cli/commands/rayuelaMensajes.test.ts src/cli/commands/rayuelaResponder.test.ts src/cli/rayuelaCommands.test.ts: 77 passing tests, including current NIA/name, ambiguous mappings, and a successful HTTP response that leaves the wrong pupil active.
